notes: Added missing API, integration, and test coverage stories for explainability layer.

stories.title: Explainability Integration with Evaluation Facade
stories.description: Integrate explainability schema into evaluate_care_facade so that all provider and clinical trial responses include structured explainability metadata derived from underlying signals.

stories.title: Explainability API Contract Enforcement
stories.description: Ensure all outbound API/tool responses conform to the explainability schema via Pydantic models or validation layer, preventing malformed or incomplete explainability data from reaching the frontend.

stories.title: End-to-End Explainability Rendering in Chat Flow
stories.description: Ensure explainability metadata flows end-to-end from backend services through tool_router into chat responses and is correctly rendered within conversational output without breaking message formatting.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Explainability Layer
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema compliance, correct population of source/meaning/limitations fields, and proper handling of missing or inconsistent data across provider and trial signals.

per_feature.mitigation: Enforce strict schema validation and fallback messaging for missing fields
